minitest: minitest: the test runner this pack reads, and the pack's name
test_: minitest: the prefix of a test method's name
_: rails: what joins the words of a test block's description in the method name it defines
test: suss: code-unit kind; also rails: declares a test as a block given its description
setup: rails: runs a block before each test; also minitest: the method run before each test
before_setup: minitest: the hook run before setup
skip: minitest: stops a test and marks it skipped
assert: minitest: the prefix of its assertions
refute: minitest: the prefix of its negative assertions
must_: minitest: the prefix of its spec expectations
wont_: minitest: the prefix of its negative spec expectations
stub: minitest: replaces a method on an object for the length of a block
stubs: mocha: replaces a method on an object
expects: mocha: replaces a method on an object and expects it to be called
